cells.quote: The bivariate analysis using chi-square statistics revealed that knowledge of oral complications of cancer therapy was significantly associated with the study level, with dental interns demonstrating a higher level of knowledge than senior dental students (29.7% vs. 21.6%, p < 0.05).
cells.note: No educational treatment was assigned; study level was a measured learner-group association.

O.outcome_detail: knowledge of oral care and health management for cancer patients

cells.note: No educational treatment was assigned; gender was a measured learner-group association.
